note: Hyperion AI Agent library (PRD §11.9). Each agent: what it automates, its trigger, and its output.

agents.name: Inventory Shortfall Agent
agents.automates: Watches stock vs demand and flags shortfalls before they cause stockouts

agents.name: Replenishment Agent
agents.automates: Drafts purchase/replenishment orders from reorder points and lead times

agents.name: Production Planning Agent
agents.automates: Builds daily production plans from demand and capacity

agents.name: QC Approval Agent
agents.automates: Tracks QC status, reminds the responsible team, escalates pending approvals
agents.trigger: Batch submitted for QC or QC pending beyond SLA
agents.output: QC status, pending alerts, escalation summary

agents.name: Vendor Follow-Up Agent
agents.automates: Chases vendors on open POs and confirmations

agents.name: Dispatch Exception Agent
agents.automates: Detects dispatch delays and routes exceptions

agents.name: PO Appointment Agent
agents.automates: Books and manages inbound dock appointments for POs

agents.name: Daily MIS Agent
agents.automates: Compiles and sends daily operations MIS

agents.name: ERP Action Agent
agents.automates: Turns ERP data into operational actions and follow-ups

agents.name: Approval Routing Agent
agents.automates: Routes approvals to the right people and chases slow ones
